records.claim_text: R07 should distinguish an observed case contrast, a source-supported contextual mechanism, a hypothesis for later cases and an unestablished group difference. Compare relevant work, scope, horizon and evidence type before attributing differences to size, sector or geography.
records.locator: Application of framework questions4,7–8,11–14; actual comparison basis remains source/case-specific
records.limitations: No representative subgroup claim, numerical threshold for valid qualitative comparison, ranking of employers, regression or causal decomposition. Sparse coverage is an explicit gap, not a zero or proof groups are the same.
